subject: Sorry about yesterday
text: Hi there! As your volunteer, I owe you an apology for yesterday’s mix-up. I realize the paperwork did not match what you expected, and we clearly saw things differently for a bit. I am really sorry if that came across as pushy, because that was never my intention. You deserve a smooth start as a new client, so I am double-checking your file today and will send corrected details before noon. Thanks for being patient!
